evidence: Judge agent+model pinned once in task.toml:30-35 [verifier.env] (REWARDKIT_JUDGE="claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL="z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", OpenRouter base URL), byte-identical to the template block; no judge.toml names a model, effort or temperature (grep of tests/**/judge.toml finds only the comment lines 2-3), each keeps only the expected judge = "claude-code" fallback. tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template and pins @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1 and harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (lines 16-31); the browser comes from the Playwright bundled with @playwright/mcp, which an existing verifier image (cw-editor-verifier:current, run with --rm) shows is exact-pinned ("playwright": "1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-05") with /opt/playwright-browsers/chromium-1237 and claude 2.1.281; every judge.toml launches playwright-mcp with --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium. tests/tools/score.py, restart_mcp.py, test.sh and scoring.toml are byte-identical to the template (diff empty). Graded time rules use the fixed clock: integration.md:7 states 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z, app_context.md:29 repeats it, the golden server.js:32-33/143 computes retention as CLOCK_MS - Date.parse(at); criteria in functional judge.toml:126-127 (K-10 at 2026-05-05T11:00:00Z must be gone, K-11 one second younger must be shown) and timer_changes:137-143 (4 May probate visible on 30-day timer) would fail a conforming-looking app that used the real run date (2026-10-09), since that app would erase K-11 and the 4 May messages; so run-date apps cannot pass and fixed-clock apps are not penalised by the run date. Conforming alternative check: a fixed-clock app with any display format passes (app_context.md:29 allows any clear format). Residual (not a defect for this row): base images are tag-pinned (node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim), not digest-pinned, but that is template-controlled and identical to the template; open verifier network is explicitly not a defect; temperature/prompt-version markers are not required by the public row (the Internal sheet's stricter annotation is superseded by the public row text and delivery profile). LLM judge outcomes remain inherently non-deterministic and no full configured judge run exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope), but that measurement belongs to other runtime rows, not this pinning row.
